comments_public_short: Comments are stored publicly in GitHub Issues; attachments and links are publicly accessible.
comments_public_warning: Comments are stored publicly in GitHub Issues, and anyone may read them on GitHub or through the API. These options only control how this blog page displays a comment; they do not provide privacy.
comments_scope_info_public: Public: every visitor to this page can see it.
comments_scope_info_commenter: Commenter only: only the author of that comment can see it after signing in.
comments_scope_info_blogger: Blogger only: only the blogger configured for this site can see it after signing in.
comments_scope_info_note: These options only control how this blog page displays a comment. The comments service decides and enforces the result. Every comment remains publicly stored in GitHub Issues.
comments_authoritative_note: The comments service decides which comments and counts are visible.
comments_composer_hint: Enter to send · Shift+Enter for a new line
comments_too_long_error: Comments can be at most 5,000 characters.
comments_loaded: Comments loaded from the comments service.
comments_empty_hint: Be the first to leave a response. Comments are stored publicly in GitHub Issues.
comments_error_generic: Could not load comments. Try again later.
comments_service_unconfigured_hint: Set params.comments.backendURL to enable comments. Nothing is loaded or submitted now.
comments_service_invalid: The comments service URL is invalid
comments_service_invalid_hint: The comments service URL must be a valid http(s) URL.
comments_service_disabled_hint: The service has no comments repository enabled, so only an unavailable state can be shown.
comments_config_generated: No comment_id was set, so a stable identifier was generated from the article path
comments_config_generated_hint: Changing the article path creates a new comment thread.
comments_session_error: Could not read the sign-in state.
comments_draft_restored: Restored the comment draft saved before sign-in.
comments_publish_hidden: The comment was saved. With the selected page display scope, the current visitor will not see it on this page.
comments_visibility_commenter_title: Public page display metadata: only that comment's author sees it here after signing in. The comment is still public on GitHub.
comments_visibility_blogger_title: Public page display metadata: only the site's configured blogger sees it here after signing in. The comment is still public on GitHub.
comments_attachment_public: Attachments and links are public once uploaded and need no sign-in to access.
comments_attachment_unavailable: Attachments unavailable: server attachment storage is not configured
comments_attachment_login: Sign in to add an attachment.
comments_attachment_auth_unavailable: GitHub sign-in is not configured, so attachments are unavailable.
comments_attachment_ready: Attachments are enabled (max {size}). Attachments and links are public and need no sign-in after upload.
comments_attachment_success: Attachment uploaded and inserted as Markdown.
comments_attachment_failed: Attachment upload failed. Try again later.
comments_attachment_too_large: The attachment exceeds the server limit (max {size}).
comments_attachment_invalid_type: This attachment type is not supported.
comments_attachment_disabled_error: Attachments unavailable: server attachment storage is not configured.
comments_login_required: Sign in with GitHub before commenting.
comments_login_expired: Your session expired. Sign in again. Your draft is preserved.
comments_login_unavailable: GitHub sign-in is not configured, so commenting, attachments, and reactions are unavailable.
comments_account_guest_hint: Sign in to comment, react, or add attachments.
comments_account_unavailable_hint: The comments service could not be reached. Try again or reload the page.
comments_login_hint: Sign in to comment, react, or add attachments.
comments_login_unconfigured_hint: GitHub OAuth has not been configured. Public comments remain readable, but commenting, reactions, and attachments are unavailable.
comments_auth_oauth_exchange_failed: The GitHub sign-in exchange failed. Try again later.
comments_auth_profile_failed: Could not read the GitHub profile.
comments_auth_missing_code: The GitHub callback is missing required parameters.
comments_auth_invalid_state: The sign-in state expired. Sign in again.
comments_auth_invalid_return_to: The sign-in return address was invalid.
comments_reactions_ready: Likes and dislikes come from real GitHub Issue reactions.
comments_reactions_login: Sign in with GitHub to react.
comments_reactions_auth_unconfigured: GitHub sign-in is not configured, so reactions are unavailable.
comments_reactions_unavailable: Reaction data is unavailable, so reactions cannot be used.
comments_reactions_error: Could not save the reaction. Try again later.
comments_reactions_session_error: The sign-in state is unavailable, so reactions cannot be used.
comments_network_error: Could not reach the comments service. Check the network, backend URL, and CORS settings.
comments_error_session: Your session expired. Sign in again.
comments_error_csrf: Security validation failed. Reload the page and try again.
comments_error_origin: This site is not in the comments service's permitted origins.
comments_error_permission: GitHub denied permission for this write. Check the account or repository settings.
comments_error_not_found: The comment thread or comments resource was not found.
comments_error_duplicate: The same comment was just submitted. Avoid sending it twice.
comments_error_validation: GitHub rejected the comment during validation. Check the content and try again.
comments_error_server: The comments service is temporarily unavailable. Try again later.
comments_error_github_unavailable: The comments service could not reach GitHub. Try again later.
comments_error_github: GitHub returned an unexpected error. Try again later.
comments_error_unknown: The comment action failed. Try again later.
comments_error_upload_failed: Attachment upload failed. Try again later.
comments_error_attachments_disabled: Attachments unavailable: server attachment storage is not configured.
comments_error_too_large: The file or request exceeds a server limit.
comments_error_invalid_type: The server rejected this attachment type.
comments_publish_filtered: Comment published and stored publicly in GitHub Issues; this page follows the selected display scope.
comments_no_js_notice: Comments, reactions, and attachments require JavaScript. The article remains readable.
search_no_results_hint: Try a title, tag, or a phrase from the article.
comments_unconfigured_dock: Comments are not configured on this site. Writing and sending are unavailable.
comments_quote_unlocated: This passage could not be located in the current article.
comments_refresh_failed: Comment published, but the list could not be refreshed. Reload the page to see it.
comments_reaction_partial: GitHub applied only part of the change. The state was refreshed.
comments_reaction_unknown: The reaction change may already have been applied, but GitHub's current state could not be read. The page will refresh the reaction state; if it cannot, reload before trying again.
comments_reaction_conflict: The reaction state changed elsewhere. The displayed state has been refreshed; review it before trying again.
